t3.source: raw recompute: shipped pipeline over inputs/cw/cw_r_eval_* (per-episode split + per-episode decoy manifest); mean +- sample std over 45 episodes per cell

md_crosscheck.source: v9 report section 3.1 rows CW-R<scale>host-<arm> (sync-on cells, 45 episodes); means must agree with the recompute to 1e-4

_spearman.source: shipped pipeline, all 810 RL eval episodes (15 per configuration x 54 arm-scale-trainseed-sync configurations), all-action vs success-only (failed red actions blanked)

_patterns.source: cell means over 45 episodes under both counting conventions (all_action = Table 3; success_only = failed red actions blanked)

t5.source: results/cage4_pipeline_fixed/*/ep_*/metrics_table.csv last row (3 episodes per configuration, mean +- sample std); Steps = mean count of red_action != sleep in inputs/cage4/ep_*.csv (rounded)

t4.source: md report source: report/phase5_report_cn_v9.md section 3.1 table (rows CW-AT/CWX-AT/CW-RT/CWX-RT); underlying per-episode metrics of the training corpora are not shipped in full

sources.flag: raw inputs: share of red actions (excluding sleep/nothing and subnet scans) whose success flag is TRUE, pooled over the corpus
sources.flag_core: raw inputs: the same success-flag rate restricted to the md core attacks (exploit / lateral-movement / privilege-escalation / impact); recorded to show that the paper does NOT use this denominator
sources.sync_off_A: inputs/cw/cw_r_eval_A_*_sync0_*.csv.decoys.json (per-episode decoy manifests; three scales x 45 episodes)
sources.t2: inputs/cw and inputs/cage4 file/episode counts; training-corpus episode counts (300 per scale B1, 50 per scale ART, 10/5 long-horizon) from v9 section 3.1 (md source; only ep001 of each training run is shipped)

crossarm.strike_basis: share of all logged red steps whose target lies in the per-episode decoy manifest (any-target); mean of five episodes per pair

paired.design: v9 section 6.7: 4 variants x 2 conditions x 45 paired rollouts (seeds 43..87), sign-flip permutation 20,000 resamples, two-sided, Holm m=4

patterns.source: cell means over 45 episodes under both counting conventions (all_action = Table 3; success_only = failed red actions blanked)
